lines.note: Ge'ez 1 combines the title with the fool's declaration; Ge'ez 2 completes Greek 2.
Ge'ez 6 bridges Greek 5's closing clause and Greek 6's fear clause, requiring the three Ge'ez verses to be joined.
Ge'ez 8 gives salvation from Zion and the return from captivity; Ge'ez 9 completes Greek 7 with Jacob and Israel rejoicing.
